name: cgauwavf
expr: [p1, x] = cgauwavf(-5, 5, 11); [p2, ~] = cgauwavf(-5, 5, 11, 2); r1 = real(p1); i1 = imag(p1); r2 = real(p2); i2 = imag(p2);
comment: Sig: [psi, x] = cgauwavf(LB, UB, N[, p]). Complex Gaussian wavelet (-1)^p · H_p(t + i/2) · exp(-t² - i·t). Trapezoidal L² normalization on the requested grid (matches MATLAB's grid-dependent normalization).
